groups.description: One shared field frame contains five long, approximately equally separated horizontal lines, each ending in a right-pointing arrowhead. The top and bottom lines do not intersect the tilted loop. The second, third and fourth lines cross its edge-on outline. The central field line coincides with the independently emphasized B vector for part of its length.
uncertainties: The apparent equal field-line spacing is schematic, not a numerical distance calibration.
Line thickness and scanning noise do not specify separate field magnitudes.

groups.description: One long narrow closed wire-loop outline tilts from lower-left to upper-right. Two near-parallel long contours join through rounded ends. Its center is at the middle field line. This is an edge-on projection of a planar loop, not a front-view filled rectangle. There is no area label S or separate rotation axle in the pixels.

Two emphasized directed rays share a tail at the center of the loop: B points horizontally right along the middle field line, and n points diagonally down-right, visually normal to the loop's tilted edge. Both have arrowheads. B is labelled above its ray and n below its ray; each label has a small vector accent. One curved angular stroke between the rightward B ray and the down-right n ray is labelled alpha. No visible point label O, numeric angle, or right-angle square is independently identifiable.
uncertainties: The small thick angular stroke is degraded; its detailed curvature is not calibrated. The alpha label unambiguously occupies the sector between B and n.
Perpendicularity is the semantic normal/plane relationship supported by the approved text, not a recovered numerical angle in the PNG.
Vector lengths do not encode numerical magnitudes.

groups.description: One curved rotation arrow rises from the upper-left of the loop center, bends across the upper side and points downward at the upper-right of the center. In this projection it follows the clockwise direction. It is separate from the small alpha angle stroke.
uncertainties: The projected curved arrow does not supply a numerical angular speed, elapsed time, or accumulated phase value.

groups.description: No physical apparatus housing, controls, electrical leads, subfigure letters, coordinate axes, grids, ticks, units or numerical calibration are visible. The source has one subfigure and three mathematical labels: B, n and alpha.
